title: Algebraic models for equivariant rational homotopy theory for discrete groups
summary: We provide a framework which generalizes algebraic models of a homotopy theory of spaces to the genuine equivariant case for a discrete group. We explain how this applies to commutative differential graded algebra (cdga) models and complete differential graded Lie algebra models for rational spaces. We compare the cdga model to other model categories in the literature, correcting some mistakes in previous approaches.
